response.original_title: Le Cruel et Curieux Vie Du La Salmonellapod
response.overview: Bag's mock nature show stars an amphibious, carnivorous flying animal, the Salmonellapod. A hushed narrator cheerfully describes the lethal male pregnancy, inborn female sadism, infant cannibalism, and other facts about the Salmonellapod's vicious life cycle, with light Casio-keyboard accompaniment. Performed entirely with marionettes made of animal parts, Le Cruel et Curieux Vie Du La Salmonellapod is not merely a satire about human interpretations of the animal kingdom, but a darker joke about the mirth and horror of living.
response.title: Le Cruel et Curieux Vie Du La Salmonellapod
